name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Taking of the Spirit) — 1 Basic — Mind Leech

system.description: Drains a portion of the victim's mental stamina, leaving her listless and distracted without any obvious cause. Win a Static Mental Challenge against her Mental Traits; she must bid an extra Trait on all Mental Challenges for the rest of the scene. Usable only once per scene on a given target, though multiple infernalists may stack it.
